div.t-att-style: ('width: %smm; height: %smm; position: relative; ' 'overflow: hidden; page-break-after: %s; ' 'font-family: sans-serif;') % ( paper_w, paper_h, 'auto' if lbl_index == lbl_size - 1 else 'always')

img.t-att-style: ('position: absolute; top: %smm; left: %smm; ' 'width: %smm; height: %smm; object-fit: contain;') % ( config.logo_y_mm, config.logo_x_mm, config.logo_width_mm, config.logo_height_mm)

div.t-att-style: ('position: absolute; top: %smm; left: %smm; ' 'width: %smm; font-size: %spt; ' 'font-weight: %s; line-height: 1.1; ' 'overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; ' 'text-overflow: ellipsis;') % ( config.title_y_mm, config.title_x_mm, config.title_width_mm, config.title_size_pt, 700 if config.title_bold else 400)

('position: absolute; top: %smm; left: %smm; ' 'width: %smm; font-size: %spt; ' 'color: #555; line-height: 1.1; ' 'overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; ' 'text-overflow: ellipsis;') % ( config.subtitle_y_mm, config.subtitle_x_mm, config.subtitle_width_mm, config.subtitle_size_pt)

img.t-att-style: ('position: absolute; top: %smm; left: %smm; ' 'width: %smm; height: %smm; ' 'object-fit: fill;') % ( config.barcode_y_mm, config.barcode_x_mm, config.barcode_width_mm, config.barcode_height_mm)

div.t-att-style: ('position: absolute; top: %smm; left: %smm; ' 'width: %smm; font-size: %spt; ' 'font-family: monospace; text-align: center; ' 'line-height: 1;') % ( config.barcode_y_mm + config.barcode_height_mm + 0.5, config.barcode_x_mm, config.barcode_width_mm, config.human_readable_size_pt)
